nodes.summary:
Let $
abla$ be a covariant derivative on the tangent bundle of a smooth manifold $M$. For vector fields $X, Y, Z$ on $M$, the curvature of $
abla$ is the vector field $R(X,Y)Z = 
abla_X 
abla_Y Z - 
abla_Y 
abla_X Z - 
abla_{[X,Y]} Z$, where $[X,Y]$ is the Lie bracket of $X$ and $Y$.
nodes.title: Riemann curvature of a covariant derivative

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a compact, Hausdorff, simply connected smooth manifold without boundary, of dimension $d \ge 2$, with a smooth Riemannian metric. Suppose $M$ carries a smooth covariant derivative $\nabla$ on its tangent bundle that is torsion-free, compatible with the metric and strictly quarter-pinched (every sectional curvature at an orthonormal pair lies in $(1, 4]$). nodes.title: Differentiable sphere theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\nabla$ be a covariant derivative on the tangent bundle of a Riemannian manifold $M$, with curvature $R$. Then $\nabla$ is strictly quarter-pinched when, for all smooth vector fields $X, Y$ on $M$ and every point $x \in M$ at which $X(x)$ and $Y(x)$ are orthonormal, the sectional curvature $K = \langle R(X,Y)Y(x), X(x) \rangle$ satisfies $1 < K \le 4$. The interval $(1, 4]$ is Knill's normalization of strict…

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
